description: Approved hours for one pay period as CSV for a payroll provider: one row per person per day with work, drive, shop, break and paid hours (2 decimals). Waiting or running time is left out; check ready. Owner or office.

date.description: Any day in the pay period (default today, shop time zone).

from.description: Custom range start instead of the shop's pay period (with to, at most 63 days).

offset.description: -1 for the period before, 1 for the next.

name: payroll_exportCsv
